name: race_stacked_fall_wave
description: A Holdfast that falls with two waves on its road fell on the older one (contract-m8 §2, design 2.7): Tide Race, seat 1 (team 0, present) with two arrows by the Welling calls wave 2 during wave 1, and wave 1's first Gourdling is held far down the road (logged setters) so wave 1 stays on the road while the arrows kill creeps of both waves. Team 0's lives set to 0 then (a setter): it fell on wave 1, its waves cleared plus one, and the fall's kills are those of wave 1's own creeps, not of every creep since the last horn; the kills of wave 2 stand apart (SimTeam.stack_kills). EV_RACE says fell on wave 1, cleared_waves(0) is 0, and the race is decided by the fall once the caretaker's team has cleared wave 1.

steps.msg: two arrows by the Welling, wave 1 walks

steps.assert: before[0] == PackedInt32Array([1, 2]) and before[1] > 0 and before[2] > 0 and before[3]
steps.msg: both waves on the road, creeps of each killed, wave 1's held Gourdling alive
it fell on wave 1, the oldest on its road, with wave 1's own kills; no wave cleared
the rival won once it cleared wave 1
